cases.name: Randi Jean Hutchings Shelton
cases.about: Her obituary said she was a clerk with Warren County Apparel. Her employer shared on social media, “She and Thea were both sweet souls. They were greatly loved and will forever remain in our hearts.”
cases.narrative: On 3/08/2026, their bodies were discovered during a welfare check. Investigators later determined that Joseph allegedly shot and killed Randi and their young daughter before taking his own life.
